verdict.rationale: Render's docs explicitly state 'Connect your repo and ship with every push' and support rollbacks, environment variables, and Blueprint YAML deploys, and community feedback corroborates ease of git-based deployment vs. competitors like Heroku. missing for 10: no hands-on trace of the auto-deploy pipeline (e.g. build logs, webhook triggers) beyond the marketing/docs claim, and no independent verification of push-to-deploy latency or reliability.
